name: Dual Weapon Charge
body:
You can strike a foe with two weapons at the end of your charge.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): When making a charge attack you may attack with a weapon in each hand, when doing so you do not gain an attack bonus from charging, and you take an additional -2 penalty to AC.
